question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Full query: monthly max index composition with rolling average and lagged values
WITH monthly_avgs AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, AVG(composition / index_value) as avg_comp_index
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE (month_year IS NOT NULL)
      AND (( _year = 2018 AND _month >= 9) OR (_year = 2019 AND _month <= 8))
    GROUP BY month_year, interest_id
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT month_year, interest_id, avg_comp_index,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_comp_index DESC) as rn
    FROM monthly_avgs
),
top_interests AS (
    SELECT mm.month_year, mm.interest_id, mm.avg_comp_index as max_index_comp, im.interest_name
    FROM monthly_max mm
    JOIN interest_map im ON mm.interest_id = im.id
    WHERE mm.rn = 1
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT t.month_year, t.interest_name, t.max_index_comp,
           AVG(t.max_index_comp) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
               ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_3m,
           LAG(t.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev_interest_name,
           LAG(t.max_index_comp, 1) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev_max_index_comp,
           LAG(t.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev2_interest_name,
           LAG(t.max_index_comp, 2) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(t.month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)) as prev2_max_index_comp
    FROM top_interests t
)
SELECT month_year, interest_name, max_index_comp, rolling_avg_3m,
       prev_interest_name, prev_max_index_comp,
       prev2_interest_name, prev2_max_index_comp
FROM ordered
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 6, 4) AS INTEGER), CAST(SUBSTR(month_year, 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
